regime_context: Detector shows Non-AI Software as the headline theme (rank 2, eligible, durable trend, high breadth 0.857) with crowding flagged as a sizing caution, while the top-ranked Memory/HBM theme is NOT trend-eligible (durability 0.24, breadth 0.0). The validated edge is only drawdown/shake-out control (gate_helps true); momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the narrowing rotation (eligible 22/49, frac 0.45) concentrates further into Non-AI Software or whether breadth re-expands. The observable I need to retire this watch: either Non-AI Software's breadth (0.857) drops below 0.6, or the rotation breadth frac rises back above 0.6 with two or more new themes turning eligible=true.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Non-AI Software is the only trend-eligible theme near the top of the leaderboard that combines a durable trend (durability_bar 0.74, hurst_tag trend), broad participation (breadth 0.857), and absolute-trend-gate eligibility. This is a stay-with-the-leader tilt on trend health and breadth, NOT a momentum-rank forecast. Crowding (crowding_z 1.45, crowded true) caps the enthusiasm but does not warrant a fade.
evidence: absolute-trend gate: eligible true (validated risk-control leg)
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.45 and crowded=true mean the theme is well-owned; attention spikes can mark tops, and the backtest shows momentum rank has ~0 forward edge — the leader can stall on profit-taking without any fundamental break.

falsifier.text: IGV lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Rank 1 on momentum score (2.175) but explicitly NOT trend-eligible (durability_bar 0.24, breadth 0.0, hurst_tag mixed). This is the canonical false-positive: the absolute-trend gate — the only validated edge — denies eligibility, so the theme has no staying power in this state. Lean is to avoid building new exposure here despite the rank.
theses.dissent: A low durability_bar can reset quickly on a sharp memory-price cycle; the theme could become trend-eligible on the next print and the high score means it is where attention/flow is concentrating.

falsifier.text: SMH closes above its 50-day average and the theme's durability_bar stays above 0.6 for five consecutive sessions

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is trend-eligible with durable-enough texture (durability_bar 0.64, breadth 0.773) and is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.98, crowded false). Among the eligible top-5 themes it offers the cleanest combination of positive momentum, eligibility, and uncrowded positioning — a diversified, non-AI-software holding for the absolute-trend-gated sleeve.
theses.dissent: Energy is macro-sensitive and mixed-hurst; if oil or natural gas prices roll over on a growth scare, the trend can break fast regardless of the detector's current breadth reading.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its 200-day moving average

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
